title: LLM4SCREENLIT: Recommendations on assessing the performance of large language models for screening literature in systematic reviews
abstract: arXiv:2511.12635v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Context: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to screen literature for systematic reviews (SRs), but the standard confusion-matrix metrics used to evaluate them can mislead under the imbalanced, cost-asymmetric conditions of screening.   Objective: We develop and justify LLM4SCREENLIT-practical recommendations for researchers conducting LLM-screening evaluations and for editors and reviewers assessing such studies-differentiated by study type (retrospective benchmarking vs deployment for a specific SR).   Method: Using Delgado-Chaves et al. (2025), an 18-LLM benchmark across three biomedical SRs, as a motivating example, we reviewed 28 additional papers and extracted their reported metrics. translated_title: LLM4SCREENLIT：关于评估大型语言模型在系统综述文献筛选中性能的建议
translated_abstract: 背景：大型语言模型（LLM）日益被用于系统综述（SR）的文献筛选，但在筛选这种类别不平衡、成本不对称的条件下，用于评估它们的标准混淆矩阵指标可能会产生误导。目的：我们为开展LLM筛选评估的研究人员以及评审此类研究的编辑和审稿人制定并论证了LLM4SCREENLIT实用建议，并按研究类型（回顾性基准测试与面向特定SR的部署）加以区分。方法：以Delgado-Chaves等人（2025）一项覆盖三个生物医学系统综述、包含18个LLM的基准测试作为启发示例，我们审阅了另外28篇论文并提取了其报告的指标。我们提出了加权马修斯相关系数，该方法将MCC的机会校正与不对称的误分类成本相结合，并在三项软件工程（SE）领域的再分析研究中进行了验证，其中规模最大的一项涵盖了
tldr: 该论文针对系统综述文献筛选中类别不平衡、误分类成本不对称导致标准混淆矩阵指标产生误导的问题，提出了LLM4SCREENLIT实用评估建议，并创新性地设计了融合机会校正与不对称误分类成本的加权马修斯相关系数指标。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LLM4SCREENLIT practical recommendations for evaluating LLM-based literature screening in systematic reviews, introducing a novel Weighted Matthews Correlation Coefficient (WMCC) that integrates MCC's chance-correction with asymmetric misclassification costs to address the misleading nature of standard confusion-matrix metrics under imbalanced, cost-asymmetric screening conditions.
